curl_heat10.note: [V x T] the INPUT movie (float32 values saved as float64), built directly on the mesh; core_stats(Hc, eye(T), frames_used, ...)

frames_used.note: the frame columns handed to core_stats (a missing frame is a column left out)

patch_frame.note: _core_patches rows (frame, sense, centre, area), ordered by frame then sense (+1 first)

steps.note: [S x 9] core_stats(steps=): sense, from-centre xyz (mm), displacement xyz (mm), track id, frame

scenario: 12 frames; 22 cores in frames 0-10 (154 entries >= 1.5, max 2.0 so hi = 8, lo = 8e-6) and ONE entry e in frame 11 chosen on a histogram bin edge, where nxr's float32 log-binning and a float64 port bin it differently (the generator searches for such an e). 7549 zeros + e = 98.0 % of 7704 entries, so the 98th percentile IS e's bin and the threshold is that bin's grid point. nxr (float32) bins e one bin higher than float64 does, so its threshold is one grid step (0.34 %) HIGHER than a float64 port's. e itself is below both thresholds (not a core).
layout: little-endian, row-major (C order); float64 or int32 .bin, no header
